zh.title: 典型AVNRT短VA机制
zh.core_insight: 快慢径折返上行传房与下行传室几乎同步，使腔内VA常≤70 ms。

bullets.label: 折返特点
bullets.text: 激动经慢径前传心室，同时经快径逆传回心房。

bullets.label: 同步激动
bullets.text: 心房与心室几乎同时除极，V波常埋住逆行A波。

bullets.label: 体表线索
bullets.text: 逆行P波常藏于QRS终末，V1导联可呈假性r'。

pearl_or_pitfall.text: 标准导联仅约45%可见逆行P波，需与窦律对照。

zh.quadrant_summary: 房室同步激动，腔内VA常≤70 ms

expanded.clinical_context: 典型慢-快型AVNRT占消融SVT的绝大多数；体表常掩盖逆行P波，需结合窦律对照或腔内VA间期确认。

en.title: Why Typical AVNRT Has Short VA
en.core_insight: Fast-pathway retrograde A overlaps antegrade ventricular V, keeping VA ≤ 70 ms.

bullets.label: Circuit
bullets.text: Slow pathway conducts down; fast pathway returns up.

bullets.label: Overlap
bullets.text: Atria and ventricles fire together; V buries retrograde A.

bullets.label: Surface ECG
bullets.text: Retrograde P hides in terminal QRS, creating pseudo-r' in V1.

pearl_or_pitfall.text: Retrograde P waves are visible on standard leads in only ~45% of cases.

expanded.clinical_context: Typical slow-fast AVNRT accounts for most ablated narrow-QRS SVTs; compare against baseline sinus ECG to spot terminal pseudo-r' deflections.

diagram.visual_goal: 在3秒内看懂体表V1假性r'与腔内His/CS通道上V波与逆行A波几乎对齐的时间关系。
must_show_elements: 体表V1导联窄QRS波及终末假性r'切迹
His束导联A波、H波、V波时序及逆行A波紧贴V波
CS导联近乎同步的V波与逆行A波
垂直虚线对齐标尺标注VA ≤ 70 ms

semantic_color_plan.black_primary: 导联基线、窄QRS轮廓、H波与V波主峰使用实心黑线绘制
semantic_color_plan.red_accent: 四色屏中逆行A波与V1假性r'切迹用红色高亮；黑白屏保留双线箭头与加粗虚线框标识
semantic_color_plan.yellow_highlight: 四色屏中VA ≤ 70 ms时间带用黄色浅底条标注；黑白/灰阶屏退化为细斜线网底

medical_accuracy_checks: 体表QRS保持窄QRS形态（≤120 ms），假性r'紧接S波之后出现
His道时序满足A-H-V顺序，H波位于V波前正常HV区间
最早逆行A波起点距V波起点 ≤ 70 ms，且与V波高度重叠

evidence.source: 2015 ACC/AHA/HRS Guideline for the Management of Adult Patients With Supraventricular Tachycardia (Page et al., Circulation 2016)
evidence.supporting_quote: note that the 90-ms interval is defined from the surface ECG [79], as opposed to the 70-ms ventriculoatrial interval that is used for intracardiac diagnosis [80]

evidence.source: Katritsis DG, Josephson ME. Differential diagnosis of regular, narrow-QRS tachycardias. Card Electrophysiol Clin / Circ Arrhythm Electrophysiol (2016)
evidence.supporting_quote: In a study on 1754 patients undergoing catheter ablation, atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia (AVNRT) was the main etiology, 56%, followed by atrioventricular reentrant tachycardia due to an accessory pathway (AVRT) 27%, and atrial tachycardia (AT) 17% [3].
